Common questions

Everything you
wanted to ask.

Do I need to request access or pay for these tools? +
No. Every tool in the kit is built by ETAD and free for all MCMC staff. Sign in with your MCMC account — that's it. No procurement forms, no licence keys, no waiting list.
Where does my data go when I use a tool? +
All tools run inside MCMC's tenant. Your inputs are processed in approved environments and never leave the organisation. See the data-handling notice on each tool's page for specifics.
How do I request a new tool for my division? +
Use the "Request a Tool" link at the top of the toolkit. Tell us the task you're stuck on — ETAD scopes new tools every fortnight, prioritised by how many divisions feel the same pain.
Can I use these tools on my phone? +
Yes. Every tool is responsive and works in mobile browsers. Heavy tools like the Stats Visualiser are usable on tablet but best on desktop.
What if a tool gives me a wrong answer? +
Click "Report" on any output. AI tools cite their sources where possible — always sanity-check important answers against the original circular or policy. We treat reports as the highest-priority bugs.
Are my usage stats visible to my supervisor? +
No individual usage is tracked or shared. Any aggregate counters are anonymous — used only to prioritise which tools to improve next.
Who should I contact if I need help or want to report an issue with a toolkit? +
For toolkit or agent-related questions, feedback, or response issues, please contact Muhammmad Amirullah Hamzah at amirullah.hamzah@mcmc.gov.my or Syafiq Haikal Syaidali at syafiq.syaidali@mcmc.gov.my. To help us review the issue quickly, please include the toolkit or agent name, a brief description of the issue, screenshots if available, and the prompt or steps that led to the problem.
